entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R. Case No. 476 of 2023 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.,(IV), Cuttack arising out of Madhupatna P.S. Case No. 160 of 2023 for commission of the offence under Sections 418/420/403/467/468/471/120B/34 of IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge(LR & LTV) Cuttack by order dated 18.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner is in custody since 07.05.2023.

Relying on the orders passed by this Court dated 21.06.2023 in BLAPL No. 6303 of 2023 and order dated 17.07.2023 in BLAPL No. 6288 of 2023, the Petitioner seeks release, inter alia, on the ground of parity.

5. It is apt to note here that while disposing of BLAPL No. 6303 of 2023, this Court took note of the affidavit filed by the informant that the matter has been amicably settled inter se between the parties.
6. Taking note of the same, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
